topic: What if GTA 6 never came out?
title: What if GTA 6 never came out?
description: A quick look at a world where the most awaited open world game never arrived.
art_style: photorealistic cinematic film still, neon sunset colours

scenes.heading: GTA 6 never came out?
scenes.narration: What if GTA 6 never came out?
scenes.image_prompt: A neon sunset over a palm tree lined coastal city, a lone sports car parked on an empty road, cinematic wide shot

scenes.heading: The most awaited game
scenes.caption: Fans around the world
scenes.narration: Fans have waited over a decade since GTA 5 launched in 2013. The hype around the next one is huge.
scenes.image_prompt: A crowd of gamers in a dark room lit by glowing screens, excited faces turned toward a big monitor, cinematic lighting

scenes.heading: Fan hype
scenes.caption: counting down for years
scenes.narration: Millions of fans have followed every trailer, leak and theory. All of it would suddenly go quiet.
scenes.image_prompt: A teenager in a dark bedroom scrolling a phone beside a glowing gaming monitor, soft blue light

scenes.narration: Streamers, modders and online communities would lose their next big world. Older games would stay on top.
scenes.image_prompt: Split view of a busy neon city street at night and the same street empty and silent at dawn, cinematic

scenes.heading: The domino effect
scenes.narration: No trailers means streamers move on. Rival studios would rush to fill the gap and players would wander off.
scenes.image_prompt: A long row of dominoes falling across a glowing neon cityscape table, shallow depth of field

scenes.heading: Release day hype
scenes.caption: the midnight launch queue
scenes.narration: No launch day. No midnight queues outside stores. No servers busy with millions of players.
scenes.image_prompt: An empty game store entrance at midnight with a long dark queue barrier and no people, neon sign glow reflected on wet ground

scenes.heading: What takes its place?
scenes.narration: Open world rivals, old favourites and indie hits would fight for the same players. The craving would stay.
scenes.image_prompt: A wide open world landscape with a winding highway, mountains and a glowing sunset, a car driving into the distance

scenes.heading: Would you miss it?
scenes.narration: So would you miss GTA 6 if it never came out? Tell me in the comments.
scenes.image_prompt: A lone sports car parked on a quiet beach road at night under palm trees and neon light, calm and thoughtful mood
